boil.definition: The temperature at which a liquid boils at sea level.

simmer.definition: Temperature just below the boiling point.

steam.definition: To cook something by letting steam pass over it.

blanch.definition: To put food briefly in boiling water, then cool it quickly.

poach.definition: To cook in a simmering liquid.

stew.definition: To cook slowly and for a long time in liquid.

braise.definition: To cook food slowly in a covered pan with a small amount of liquid.

pressure-cook.definition: To cook food quickly using steam held under high pressure.

double-boil.definition: To heat food gently in a bowl or pan above hot water.

parboil.definition: To boil food partly before finishing it another way.

bake.definition: To cook and make edible by putting in a hot oven.

roast.definition: To cook with dry heat, usually in an oven.

grill.definition: A metal surface used for cooking over a fire.

broil.definition: To cook food with direct heat from above.

toast.definition: A celebrity who receives much acclaim and attention.

char.definition: A human female employed to do housework.

smoke.definition: A hot vapor containing fine particles of carbon being produced by combustion.

dehydrate.definition: To preserve by removing all water and liquids from.

barbecue.definition: To cook outdoors on a barbecue grill.

rotisserie.definition: An oven or broiler equipped with a rotating spit on which meat cooks as it turns.

fry.definition: To cook food in hot oil or fat.

deep-fry.definition: To cook food while it is fully covered in hot oil.

saut-.definition: To cook food quickly in a little hot oil while stirring or tossing it.

stir-fry.definition: To cook small pieces of food quickly in a hot pan while stirring.

pan-fry.definition: To cook food in a pan with a small amount of oil or fat.

shallow-fry.definition: To cook food in a small amount of hot oil or fat rather than completely covering it.
shallow-fry.exampleUsage: Shallow-fry the vegetables until both sides are lightly browned.
shallow-fry.arabicTranslation: يقلي في كمية قليلة من الزيت

sear.definition: To burn slightly and superficially so as to affect color.

flambe.definition: To pour liquor over and ignite (a dish).

tempura.definition: Vegetables and seafood dipped in batter and deep-fried.

flash-fry.definition: To fry food very quickly on both sides in very hot oil.
flash-fry.exampleUsage: The cook flash-fried the thin vegetables before serving them.
flash-fry.arabicTranslation: يقلي سريعًا جدًا في زيت شديد السخونة

chop.definition: The irregular motion of waves (usually caused by wind blowing in a direction opposite to the tide).

dice.definition: Small cubes marked with numbers used in games.

slice.definition: To cut food into thin, flat pieces.

julienne.definition: A clear soup garnished with julienne vegetables.

grate.definition: To shred food into small pieces using a grater.

peel.definition: To remove the outer skin from fruit or vegetables.

crush.definition: To compress with violence, out of natural shape or condition.

blend.definition: To mix colours or marks smoothly together.

stir.definition: To mix food or liquid by moving a spoon around in it.

fold.definition: To mix a light ingredient gently into a heavier mixture.

knead.definition: To mix into a homogeneous mass.

beat.definition: A regular route for a sentry or policeman.

cream.definition: The best people or things in a group.

toss.definition: To turn ingredients over lightly to mix or coat them.

marinate.definition: To leave food in a seasoned liquid so it gains flavor.

glaze.definition: A glassy coating put on clay and hardened by heat.
